1 #!/usr/bin/env python3
2 """Anchor durable settings store — model/engine prefs (stdlib only).
3 
4 Single source of truth for the interactive default CLI and the coding/review
5 model families. Written under ``paths.WRITE_LOCK`` with atomic primary + mirror
6 writes so concurrent ThreadingHTTPServer writers and non-Anchor agents (VS Code,
7 Claude Code, Grok Build) share the same prefs.
8 
9 Primary: ``paths.data_dir() / "settings.json"``
10 Mirror:  ``~/.anchor/model_prefs.json`` (discoverable without ANCHOR_DATA_DIR)
11 
12 Display reads remain available during configuration errors. Model launches use
13 get_launch_settings(), which refuses corrupt or missing authoritative settings.
14 """

102 class SettingsInvalid(ValueError):
103     """Display may continue, but no model may launch from invalid authority."""

106 @contextmanager
107 def _settings_write_lock():
108     """Serialize UI and standalone writers across processes, not just threads."""
109     with _paths.WRITE_LOCK:
110         lock_path = settings_path().with_name(".settings.lock")
111         lock_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
112         with lock_path.open("a+b") as stream:
113             stream.seek(0, os.SEEK_END)
114             if stream.tell() == 0:
115                 stream.write(b"0")
116                 stream.flush()
117             deadline = time.monotonic() + 5
118             while True:
119                 try:
120                     stream.seek(0)
121                     if os.name == "nt":
122                         import msvcrt
123                         msvcrt.locking(stream.fileno(), msvcrt.LK_NBLCK, 1)
124                     else:
125                         import fcntl
126                         fcntl.flock(stream.fileno(), fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
127                     break
128                 except OSError:
129                     if time.monotonic() >= deadline:
130                         raise SettingsInvalid("Settings are busy; try saving again")
131                     time.sleep(0.05)
132             try:
133                 yield
134             finally:
135                 stream.seek(0)
136                 if os.name == "nt":
137                     import msvcrt
138                     msvcrt.locking(stream.fileno(), msvcrt.LK_UNLCK, 1)
139                 else:
140                     import fcntl
141                     fcntl.flock(stream.fileno(), fcntl.LOCK_UN)

144 def settings_path() -> Path:
145     """Return the fixed primary settings path for this Anchor checkout/data dir.
146 
147     Mirror content is never path authority.  In particular, its informational
148     ``primary_path`` field cannot redirect a later save to another host path.
149     """
150     return _paths.data_dir() / SETTINGS_NAME

153 def mirror_path() -> Path:
154     """Absolute path to ``~/.anchor/model_prefs.json`` (agent-discoverable mirror)."""
155     return Path.home() / MIRROR_DIRNAME / MIRROR_NAME

158 def _now_iso() -> str:
159     return datetime.now(timezone.utc).replace(microsecond=0).isoformat()

162 def _normalize(raw) -> dict:
163     """Return a complete, validated settings dict from arbitrary input.
164 
165     Unknown / invalid field values fall back to :data:`DEFAULTS`. Always returns
166     a new dict with every schema key present (including ``updated_at``).
167     """
168     out = dict(DEFAULTS)
169     out["model_policy"] = dict(DEFAULT_POLICY)
170     out["settings_revision"] = 0
171     out["provider_connections"] = _providers.default_connections()
172     from copy import deepcopy
173     out["provider_preferences"] = deepcopy(_providers.DEFAULT_PREFERENCES)
174     out["updated_at"] = _now_iso()
175     if not isinstance(raw, dict):
176         return out
177     cli = raw.get("default_cli")
178     if isinstance(cli, str) and cli.strip() in VALID_DEFAULT_CLIS:
179         out["default_cli"] = cli.strip()
180     fam = raw.get("coding_family")
181     if isinstance(fam, str) and fam.strip() in VALID_CLIS:
182         out["coding_family"] = fam.strip()
183     review = raw.get("review_family")
184     if isinstance(review, str) and review.strip() in VALID_REVIEW_FAMILIES:
185         out["review_family"] = review.strip()
186     stew = raw.get("steward_type")
187     if isinstance(stew, str) and stew.strip() in VALID_STEWARDS:
188         out["steward_type"] = stew.strip()
189     ts = raw.get("updated_at")
190     if isinstance(ts, str) and ts.strip():
191         out["updated_at"] = ts.strip()
192     if isinstance(raw.get("settings_revision"), int) and not isinstance(raw["settings_revision"], bool):
193         out["settings_revision"] = raw["settings_revision"]
194     if "model_policy" in raw:
195         try:
196             out["model_policy"] = validate_policy(raw["model_policy"])
197         except ValueError:
198             pass  # Display normalization only; read_settings_state rejects it for launch.
199     if "provider_connections" in raw:
200         out["provider_connections"] = _providers.validate_connections(raw["provider_connections"])
201     if "provider_preferences" in raw:
202         out["provider_preferences"] = _providers.validate_preferences(raw["provider_preferences"], out["provider_connections"])
203     return out

206 def _read_settings_dict(path: Path) -> dict | None:
207     """Read one settings object, returning ``None`` on any invalid input."""
208     try:
209         raw = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
210         return raw if isinstance(raw, dict) else None
211     except (OSError, json.JSONDecodeError, TypeError, ValueError):
212         return None

215 def _prefer_valid_values(preferred, fallback) -> dict:
216     """Overlay valid preference values without letting junk mask fallbacks."""
217     merged = dict(fallback) if isinstance(fallback, dict) else {}
218     if not isinstance(preferred, dict):
219         return merged
220     cli = preferred.get("default_cli")
221     if isinstance(cli, str) and cli.strip() in VALID_DEFAULT_CLIS:
222         merged["default_cli"] = cli.strip()
223     fam = preferred.get("coding_family")
224     if isinstance(fam, str) and fam.strip() in VALID_CLIS:
225         merged["coding_family"] = fam.strip()
226     review = preferred.get("review_family")
227     if isinstance(review, str) and review.strip() in VALID_REVIEW_FAMILIES:
228         merged["review_family"] = review.strip()
229     steward = preferred.get("steward_type")
230     if isinstance(steward, str) and steward.strip() in VALID_STEWARDS:
231         merged["steward_type"] = steward.strip()
232     updated_at = preferred.get("updated_at")
233     if isinstance(updated_at, str) and updated_at.strip():
234         merged["updated_at"] = updated_at.strip()
235     return merged

238 def read_settings_state() -> dict:
239     """Primary wins. Corrupt primary cannot be hidden by mirror or defaults."""
240     primary_path = settings_path()
241     try:
242         primary_exists = primary_path.exists()
243         selected_path = primary_path
244         if not primary_exists:
245             if mirror_path().exists():
246                 selected_path = mirror_path()
247         if not selected_path.exists():
248             return {"settings": _normalize(None), "valid": False, "missing": True,
249                     "error": "Model preferences are not configured", "source": str(primary_path)}
250         raw = json.loads(selected_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
251         if not isinstance(raw, dict):
252             raise ValueError("expected a settings object")
253         for key, allowed in (("default_cli", VALID_DEFAULT_CLIS), ("coding_family", VALID_CLIS),
254                              ("review_family", VALID_REVIEW_FAMILIES)):
255             if key not in raw or raw[key] not in allowed:
256                 raise ValueError(f"missing or invalid {key}")
257         validate_policy(raw.get("model_policy", DEFAULT_POLICY))
258         revision = raw.get("settings_revision", 0)
259         if not isinstance(revision, int) or isinstance(revision, bool) or revision < 0:
260             raise ValueError("invalid settings_revision")
261         result = _normalize(raw)
262         mirror = _read_settings_dict(mirror_path())
263         if selected_path == primary_path and mirror is not None:
264             if any(mirror.get(key, DEFAULT_POLICY if key == "model_policy" else 0 if key == "settings_revision" else None)
265                    != result[key] for key in ("default_cli", "coding_family", "review_family", "steward_type",
266                                              "model_policy", "settings_revision")):
267                 result["mirror_out_of_sync"] = True
268         return {"settings": result, "valid": True, "missing": False,
269                 "error": None, "source": str(selected_path)}
270     except (OSError, ValueError, TypeError) as error:
271         return {"settings": _normalize(None), "valid": False, "missing": False,
272                 "error": f"Model preferences are invalid ({type(error).__name__}); repair settings before launching AI",
273                 "source": str(primary_path)}
274

276 def load_settings() -> dict:
277     """Non-raising display contract; invalid values are explicitly NOT launchable."""
278     state = read_settings_state()
279     result = dict(state["settings"])
280     if not state["valid"]:
281         result["settings_error"] = state["error"]
282     return result

285 def get_launch_settings() -> dict:
286     state = read_settings_state()
287     if not state["valid"]:
288         raise SettingsInvalid(state["error"])
289     return dict(state["settings"])

292 def _atomic_write_json(path: Path, obj: dict) -> None:
293     """Atomic JSON write (tmp + os.replace). Caller holds WRITE_LOCK."""
294     path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
295     text = json.dumps(obj, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n"
296     _paths.backup_rotate(path)          # A4: untracked runtime state keeps its own backups
297     _paths.atomic_write_text(path, text)
298

300 def save_settings(**kwargs) -> dict:
301     """Read/merge/write one revision under the stable cross-process lock."""
302     with _settings_write_lock():
303         return _save_settings_locked(**kwargs)
304 
305 
306 def _save_settings_locked(**kwargs) -> dict:
307     """Merge partial updates into settings, validate, write primary + mirror.
308 
309     Only recognized keys (``default_cli``, ``coding_family``, ``review_family``)
310     are applied; invalid values raise :class:`ValueError`. Returns the full
311     settings dict after write. Always stamps a fresh ``updated_at``.
312     """
313     state = read_settings_state()
314     if not state["valid"] and not state["missing"]:
315         raise SettingsInvalid(state["error"])
316     current = dict(state["settings"])
317     current.pop("mirror_out_of_sync", None)
318     expected = kwargs.get("expected_revision")
319     if expected is not None and (type(expected) is not int or expected < 0):
320         raise ValueError("expected_revision must be a nonnegative integer")
321     if expected is not None and expected != current["settings_revision"]:
322         raise SettingsInvalid("Model settings changed; reload before saving")
323     for key in ("default_cli", "coding_family", "review_family"):
324         if key not in kwargs:
325             continue
326         val = kwargs[key]
327         allowed = (VALID_REVIEW_FAMILIES if key == "review_family"
328                    else VALID_DEFAULT_CLIS if key == "default_cli"
329                    else VALID_CLIS)
330         if not isinstance(val, str) or val.strip() not in allowed:
331             raise ValueError(
332                 "invalid %s %r (expected one of %s)"
333                 % (key, val, "|".join(sorted(allowed)))
334             )
335         current[key] = val.strip()
336     if "steward_type" in kwargs:
337         val = kwargs["steward_type"]
338         if not isinstance(val, str) or val.strip() not in VALID_STEWARDS:
339             raise ValueError(
340                 "invalid steward_type %r (expected one of %s)"
341                 % (val, "|".join(sorted(VALID_STEWARDS)))
342             )
343         current["steward_type"] = val.strip()
344     if "model_policy" in kwargs:
345         current["model_policy"] = validate_policy(kwargs["model_policy"])
346     if "provider_connections" in kwargs:
347         current["provider_connections"] = _providers.validate_connections(kwargs["provider_connections"])
348     if "provider_preferences" in kwargs:
349         current["provider_preferences"] = _providers.validate_preferences(kwargs["provider_preferences"], current["provider_connections"])
350     current["settings_revision"] += 1
351     current["updated_at"] = _now_iso()
352 
353     primary = settings_path()
354     mirror = mirror_path()
355     mirror_payload = dict(current)
356     mirror_payload["source"] = "anchor"
357     mirror_payload["primary_path"] = str(primary.resolve())
358 
359     with _paths.WRITE_LOCK:
360         _atomic_write_json(primary, current)
361         mirror_write_ok = True
362         try:
363             _atomic_write_json(mirror, mirror_payload)
364         except OSError:
365             # Primary stays authoritative. Report the incomplete mirror without
366             # rolling back or letting stale mirror values undo the saved choice.
367             mirror_write_ok = False
368     result = load_settings()
369     if not mirror_write_ok or any(
370         result.get(k) != current.get(k)
371         for k in ("default_cli", "coding_family", "review_family", "steward_type", "model_policy", "settings_revision")
372     ):
373         result = dict(result)
374         result["mirror_out_of_sync"] = True
375     return result

402 def export_env_overrides() -> dict:
403     """Env vars agents/engines should honor for the current settings."""
404     s = load_settings()
405     coding = s["coding_family"]
406     review = s["review_family"]
407     cross = "true" if coding != review else "false"
408     return {

410         "ANCHOR_DEFAULT_CLI": s["default_cli"],
411         "ANCHOR_CODING_FAMILY": coding,
412         "ANCHOR_REVIEW_FAMILY": review,
413         "CODING_FAMILY": coding,
414         "REVIEW_FAMILY": review,
415         "CROSS_MODEL": cross,

419 def steward_profile(settings: dict | None = None) -> dict:
420     """The ACTIVE steward persona: {key, label, desc, high_seat, seal}.
421 
422     Total — an unknown/corrupt stored value falls back to the Ecgberht
423     default, so callers can always render an icon pair.
424     """
425     s = settings if isinstance(settings, dict) else load_settings()
426     key = s.get("steward_type") or DEFAULTS["steward_type"]
427     if key not in STEWARDS:
428         key = DEFAULTS["steward_type"]
429     prof = dict(STEWARDS[key])
430     prof["key"] = key
431     return prof
